comment: A resource_skus.list(filter="location eq 'southeastasia'") response for a constrained-core SKU, Standard_E32-8s_v5 (Req 21.2, 21.3, 21.9). Its capabilities carry BOTH vCPUs ('32', the parent SKU's advertised count) and vCPUsAvailable ('8', what this SKU actually exposes) -- the SKU catalog must read vCPUsAvailable and must never fall back to vCPUs, because using vCPUs here overstates capacity by 4x and every derived per-core figure would be wrong. MemoryGB is '256', to be parsed as Decimal and multiplied by exactly 1073741824.
